extracted.name: Healthy Blueberry Breakfast Smoothie
extracted.description: Wondering what to eat for your on-the-go breakfast? Make this healthy and delicious blueberry breakfast smoothie.
ingredient_lines: 1 tablespoon white sugar, or to taste
1 pinch ground cinnamon, or to taste
instruction_lines: Blend blueberries, yogurt, orange juice, sugar, vanilla extract, and cinnamon together in a blender on low speed for 30 seconds; increase speed to high and blend until smooth, about 2 minutes. Add ice and blend on high until smooth, about 1 minute more.
